faq1Q: Does using Sezzle affect my credit score?
faq1A: No. Applying to pay with Sezzle never runs a hard credit check, so it won't impact your score. Sezzle does offer everyone the opportunity to enroll in Sezzle Up, an opt-in credit-building program.
faq2A: It does not cost anything to sign up for Sezzle and download the app. Depending on your order, a service fee (finance charge) may apply — and if it does, you'll see the exact amount before you check out, never after. A failed-payment fee of up to $15 may apply if a scheduled payment doesn't go through.
faq3A: Your first payment is taken at checkout. The remaining payments are charged automatically every 2 weeks — over 6 weeks for Pay in 4 or 8 weeks for Pay in 5.
